test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 17 May, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
**Direction: Choose the word that can substitute the given group of words.**

One who is 100 years old or older
solution:
The correct answer is **"Centenarian."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **"Centenarian"** means a person who is 100 years old or older. (वह व्यक्ति जिसकी आयु 100 वर्ष या उससे अधिक हो)

 
 
• **Example**: *My great-grandmother is a **centenarian**__ and she still enjoys gardening.*
 
 
 
• The word is derived from the Latin word **"centum" **which means hundred.
 
• It is a noun and can be used to describe someone who has reached the age of 100 or more.
 
• The correct answer is Option 1.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• Option 2 **(Immortal**) means someone who cannot die or is not subject to death. (अमर, शाश्‍वत अनश्‍वर)
 
• Option 3 (**Mortal**) means someone who is subject to death. (मरणधर्मा, नश्‍वर, मर्त्य)
 
• Option 4 (**Sententia**) is not a word in the English language and does not make sense in the given context.

208:Tac2,

The correct answer is **"went."**
